aboutPreview.description: For over nine years, in the heart of Imperia, we have cherished a simple idea: that a dinner is not just a meal, but an experience to remember. Inspired by French bistros and rooted in Ligurian tradition.

aboutPage.philosophyQuote: «We don't just serve food. We serve the luxury of fleeting time, transformed into memory.»
aboutPage.inspirationP1: Our cuisine is born from the encounter between two similar traditions: the Liguria of pestos and bluefish, and the France of mother sauces and slow cooking.
aboutPage.inspirationP2: Years spent in Liguria have taught us respect for time: the time of a stock reducing, of a braised meat cooking for six hours, of our focaccia rising.
aboutPage.seasonP1: Our menu changes with the seasons and the catch of the day. We work with small producers from the Ligurian hinterland and fishermen from the Imperia market, choosing only the best.
aboutPage.seasonP2: Ligurian tradition — pesto, pansoti, bluefish — meets French technique: mother sauces, slow cooking, classic pastry. A dialogue between two cuisines that resemble each other for their love of time and ingredients.
aboutPage.seasonQuote: «Time is the ingredient you cannot buy.»
aboutPage.hospitalityQuote: «We welcome every guest as you welcome a longtime friend: with time, with care, with the desire to make them feel at home.»
aboutPage.hospitalitySub: Our team — dining room and kitchen
aboutPage.kitchenText: Excellent raw materials, classic technique, strict seasonality. No compromises on the ingredient.
aboutPage.cellarText: A curated selection of wines. Our staff will advise you on the perfect pairing for your dishes.
aboutPage.atmosphereText: Dim lights, great care. Distant tables, soft music, candles lit every evening like a ritual.

contactPage.heroDescription: We are in the heart of Imperia, a few steps from the port. For any request — reservations, private events, business dinners — we are at your disposal.

menuPage.heroTitle: The menu changes with the seasons
menuPage.heroDescription: A cuisine that follows the market, the sea, and the garden. These are the dishes on our menu — a selection that renews every season.
menuPage.noteText: «The menu may vary depending on market availability and the season. In the absence of fresh product, frozen product may be used. For allergies and intolerances, please speak with our staff.»

reviews.quote: «Dinner with friends in a refined and elegant atmosphere. The welcome is warm, the service impeccable and timely. The menu is very appealing and varied: it nods to French cuisine while also highlighting local products. We enjoyed well-crafted and delicious dishes with great value for money. I highly recommend this wonderful place.»

«Extremely charming venue with friendly and efficient service. Varied menu with a cellar to match. Extremely fresh fish and appealing dishes skillfully served. Complete dessert section with flawless presentation. Wonderful job, we will be back soon!»

«Very elegant location, perfect both for a couple's dinner and a dinner with friends. Truly kind and knowledgeable staff. Dishes that are beautiful to look at and truly excellent to taste. It was a pleasure dining here and I will definitely return.»
